page: Microsoft Azure D96alds_v6 is an x86_64 server instance belonging to the Daldv6 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 96 dedicated vCPUs powered by an AMD processor. The instance is configured with 192.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

This server type includes 5669 GB of local NVMe SSD storage, providing high-capacity local disk space. It is also Premium Storage capable for external disk attachments. There are no integrated GPUs on this instance, and it does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given its 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the D96alds_v6 is optimized for compute-heavy workloads that require substantial processing power but have lower memory footprint requirements. The inclusion of a large local NVMe SSD makes it highly resource-efficient for workloads requiring high-speed local scratch space or temporary database storage. Suitable workloads include compute-intensive applications, batch processing, and large-scale local data processing.
